_doc: P298 beanstalk eval — RESEARCH-ONLY, ADVISORY. Scores the EXISTING beanstalk-2024-05 output (44 merged findings, prior eval2 run) on three axes: answer-key recall/precision (read-only from eval2 match_matrix + ground_truth), novelty (KB sim), validity (executed PoC where mockable / evidence-bundle+needs_execution otherwise). Answer key + contest source READ-ONLY. No fresh discovery, no audit switch.

validity_targets.mechanism: inner plot loop uses outer index i instead of inner j -> only the first plot per account is re-issued on L2, bricking the rest of each account's field migration
permissionless redeem with NO nonce/replay guard -> a valid signed redemption leaf can be replayed, redeeming the same deposits/balances more than once
unguarded external fn unwraps the contract's ENTIRE WETH balance and forwards address(this).balance to a caller-supplied `to` -> any caller drains balances left in the junction
totalDeltaB() is documented as summing ALL whitelisted minting Wells but its body returns only LibWellMinting.check(C.BEAN_ETH_WELL) -> understates total deltaB when other wells are whitelisted
Flood plenty paid on LIVE roots while the divisor uses a fixed rain.roots snapshot taken at a different time -> per-account plenty is mis-divided (over/under-paid)

reseed re-issues deposits but never initializes the global Stalk/Roots aggregates + per-account Roots -> the entire Stalk/Roots accounting starts from zero/unset (Silo bricked). Too entangled with the full reseed/Silo system to mock faithfully.
reseed facet ordering: ReseedSilo reads stalkIssuedPerBdv before ReseedWhitelist sets it -> stale/zero read. Needs the multi-facet reseed sequence.
redeem ignores verified internalBalances and zeroes them -> migrated internal balances lost. Entangled with the migration/merkle redemption accounting.
shared per-block convert-capacity accumulator front-runnable -> sandwich exhausts the shared cap. Needs AMM + multi-tx ordering.
convert max + anti-peg stalk penalty use spot getReserves() -> flash-manipulable. Needs Well/AMM + flash loan.
L1 burns Beans but the L2 receiver always reverts -> burned Beans unrecoverable. Two-sided cross-chain flow.
nested unbounded loops over fertilizerIds x accountData with external 1155 mints -> OOG on L2. Gas-exhaustion, no clean L3 state assert.
